code:
NFT locked in a vault contract
Vault mints 1,000,000 fungible ERC-20 "shares"
Each share = 1/1,000,000th claim on the NFT

If the NFT's implied value is $500,000:
  price per share = 500,000 / 1,000,000 = $0.50

50,000 shares ($25,000) = 5% fractional ownership
-- no need for $500,000 or sole custody
caption: A single binary buy/don't-buy decision becomes tradeable in small amounts.

code:
Borrower deposits an NFT (floor value: ~$20,000)
Protocol offers a loan at 40% loan-to-value: $8,000

Repay + interest  -> NFT returned
Default            -> NFT liquidated to cover the loan

Lower LTV than fungible-asset lending --
pricing a single NFT is harder than a liquid token
caption: Same overcollateralized mechanics as Lesson 10, applied to a unique asset.
